maps.title: Straight lane
maps.purpose: Basic forward/reverse steering with forgiving gravel shoulders and terminal outside.

maps.title: Right-angle turn
maps.purpose: Learn to turn into a new corridor rather than continue into the terminal boundary.

maps.title: Four-way intersection
maps.purpose: Introduce crossing paths with initially generous approach distances.

maps.title: Single lane with passing bay
maps.purpose: A yielding/reversing car can retreat into the bay to let another car pass.

maps.title: Blind alley
maps.purpose: A 3 m terminal-walled capped branch is too narrow for a U-turn, so the car must reverse to the main road.

maps.title: Dead end with detour
maps.purpose: The direct branch ends at Terminal; reaching the forward-side goal requires reversing to the main road and taking the lower bypass.

maps.title: S-curve
maps.purpose: Follow continuous road geometry through alternating bends rather than memorising a single corner.

maps.title: Close-range traffic plaza
maps.purpose: Four nearby cars have forward goals on open asphalt, isolating vehicle negotiation from road-boundary following.
